clauses.original_text: Responsibility should be allocated ex ante across the AI development chain (model developers, application deployers, cloud providers) based on each party's level of control, in a manner analogous to cloud shared-responsibility models, complemented by ex post safety nets such as indemnities and insurance for end users.
clauses.actor: model developers, application deployers, cloud providers
clauses.object: generative AI risks along the development chain
clauses.purpose: incentivise responsible behaviour and protect end users

clauses.original_text: Developers and deployers should adopt baseline safety and hygiene practices across the model lifecycle (e.g. fine-tuning for alignment, evaluation) and provide meaningful transparency to users, akin to 'food labels', on data used, training, safety evaluations, risks and intended use.
clauses.requirement: baseline safety practices and standardised disclosure
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase, not verbatim: the official document could not be fetched from the compilation environment (issuer site blocked by network policy); content reconstructed from secondary summaries and compiler knowledge.

clauses.original_text: Organisations should establish structures and processes for incident monitoring and reporting, including vulnerability reporting (e.g. bug bounties) before incidents occur, and timely notification of serious incidents to stakeholders and authorities as appropriate.
clauses.action: monitor and report incidents and vulnerabilities
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase, not verbatim: the official document could not be fetched from the compilation environment (issuer site blocked by network policy); content reconstructed from secondary summaries and compiler knowledge.

clauses.original_text: Generative AI should be subject to external validation and third-party testing against common standards and benchmarks to provide independent assurance and build trust.
clauses.requirement: independent third-party testing using common standards

clauses.original_text: Security-by-design should be adapted to generative AI, including new threat-modelling approaches and tools such as input moderation/filters and digital forensics tools for generative AI.
clauses.purpose: address novel threats such as prompt attacks

clauses.original_text: Technical solutions such as digital watermarking and cryptographic provenance should be used to show where content came from and whether it was AI-generated or modified, supported by work with key stakeholders and user education.
